tasks_completed.description: Nth Absolute Cinema (NAC) — Sprint 0 Architecture Freeze and Sprint 1 MVP Studio Build
tasks_completed.notes: Full MVP implementation from brainstorm to working code. Sprint 0: Named NAC separately from CRP TITAN, froze five-graph architecture, 14 v1.0 spec docs, 8-question gate passed. Sprint 1: Built nac.Studio SDK (pip-installable), provider abstraction (Ollama->OpenRouter->Mock), Story/Screenplay/Audio/Prompt compilers, Capability Registry, Production Package export, CLI, thin bridge, real example (temple_of_varuna with 21.8MB narrated audio). Live verification via OpenRouter free tier. 40+ commits, 49/49 tests green. Bugs found/fixed: Windows cp1252 console encoding crash (ASCII markers), pyrefly editable install resolution (added to pyrefly.toml search-path). Subagent verification lesson: caught false status report by checking git/filesystem instead of trusting report.

tasks_completed.description: Sprint 2A Director Studio UI: FastAPI + vanilla HTML/CSS/JS dashboard, 13+ REST routes, left/center/right/bottom panel layout, command palette. Real-world verification found 4 critical bugs (unhandled 429 rate-limit, ThreadPoolExecutor timeout semantics, PATH issue, commit message vs git state). Full 18-step UAT PASS. Demo project seeding. PR #1 open (85/85 tests). Character Genome Spec v1.2 frozen + merged (PR #2). Architecture reframe: departments inside a film studio. Handoff to Antigravity for Sprint 2B.
tasks_completed.notes: Verification-heavy session. Real-world UAT forced bug fixes test suites missed. Explicit freeze on further spec work. Sprint 2B authorized pending fresh approval.

routing_corrections: Auto-logged by session-memory subagent as 'Claude Haiku 4.5, Tier 2' - corrected post-hoc to 'Claude Sonnet 5, Tier 4' (actual model per system info). Same class of error as a prior NAC session (see memory: mvct/nac model-misrecording incident) - the subagent has no ground truth on which model is actually running and should not be trusted to self-report this field without a human/primary-session correction pass.

tasks_completed.description:
NAC Director Studio V2: ground-up React/TS/Vite rewrite of the Director Studio UI in E:
th-absolute-cinema (separate repo, feat/director-studio-v2), executed as 3 explicit human-reviewed gates. Gate A: Vite+React+TS+Tailwind v4+shadcn deps+React Router+Zustand+React Query+Framer Motion scaffold wired live to the existing FastAPI backend via CORS (693a5a1). Gate B: layout (AppLayout/TopBar/Sidebar/InspectorPanel/BottomTimeline/Workspace), real routing, Zustand split 4 ways, typed API layer by resource, design system with department/status color tokens (052a497). Gate C: Welcome rewrite (real per-project progress %, real activity feed from reviews+packages, Demo Project) and a 3-step Creation Wizard with a large visual aspect-ratio picker, verified live end-to-end creating a real project through the actual browser (c42830f). Also restructured wiki/nac-next-steps.md into wiki/CURRENT.md/DECISIONS.md/ROADMAP.md/CHANGELOG.md in navakanth001 (f2b33386) and wrote a HANDOFF TO ANTIGRAVITY section for cold-start pickup.
tasks_completed.notes: Multi-gate build with mandatory stop-and-review after each gate, set up specifically to avoid the earlier Sprint 2A pattern of declaring complete then finding bugs. Every gate verified live in a real browser (screenshots, console/network checks, actual project creation) before being reported done, not just built. One deliberate deviation from the user's own product-brief mockup (aspirational outputs like Thumbnail/Character Art rendered as "Soon" instead of fabricated, per the frozen No Mock UI rule) was surfaced explicitly rather than silently applied.
